notes.note: Story 1.3's test scope names a campaign-navigation run but no campaign-navigation spec exists, and chrome's scope holds no e2e/**. The join layer (scope **, verify pnpm test:static && pnpm test:e2e) must add e2e/specs/campaign-navigation.spec.ts before its full run: an Admin/Preacher/Assistant sees Campaign in the desktop pill and the phone bottom nav pointing at /campaigns; a Volunteer with an active dialer_callers profile sees it pointing at /campaigns/assignments; a Volunteer without one sees no Campaign item at all. Without it the header routing this layer added ships unproven.
